evidence.note: 'Thank you' is set in near-black ink; no role colour is used for emphasis.
Full-strength blue appears only on the active 'Close' nav item and the header rule beneath the nav, both marking current position (focus).
Soft, low-saturation blue blurred blobs wash the right and lower background; they are a pale ambient tint, not the focus blue at full strength. No red, amber or green state/loss/alarm colours appear.

rationale: The only saturated role colour (blue) marks focus on the active nav item and the header rule, and the text stays neutral ink. The background blobs are a pale tint of the same hue used as an ambient backdrop, not role colour applied to content, and no state, loss or alarm colour is misused. Each colour therefore stays in its declared role.
